content: Elihu a falane: Ala adamadiine xaranma kii naxan yi
Elihu mɔn yi siga falan ma, a naxa,

content.text: “I mɔn xa tin ndedi, n xa i xaran,
amasɔtɔ fala gbegbe mɔn n xɔn
n naxan falɛ i xa Ala fe ra.
N nan n ma kolonna fenma yire makuyen nin,
n yi yoon fi Ala ma naxan n daxi.
Wule mi n ma falane ra mumɛ.
N tan naxan be i yɛtagi,
n ma fekolonna kamalixi.”
“Ala sɛnbɛn gbo yati,
a mi muxu yo rawolima ayi.
A sɛnbɛn gbo a xaxilimayaan xɔn.
A mi ɲaxudene luma e nii ra.
A kiti kɛndɛn sama yiigelitɔne xa.
A mi a xun xanbi soma tinxin muxune yi,
koni a e fe yitema nɛn,
a yi e dɔxɔ manga gbɛdɛne yi habadan.
Xa e xidixi yɔlɔnxɔnne ra,
xa e tɔrɔni,
Ala e kɛwanle nan makɛnɛnma e xa na kiini,
e nun e murutɛ feene
e naxanye ligaxi wasoni.
A yi e xaran,
a e xa e tuli mati e xuru falane ra,
a yi e yamari,
a e xa xɛtɛ e hakɛn fɔxɔ ra.
Xa e tuli mati,
e yi a yamarin suxu,
e siimayaan danguma hɛrin nin,
e yi e dunuɲa yi gidin ɲan sɛwani.
Xa e mi a ramɛ,
e faxama nɛn yɛngɛni,
e halagi e fe kolontareyani.”
“Ala kolontarene nan xɔlɔn namarama,
e mi Ala maxandima malina fe ra
hali a na e ratɔrɔn.
E faxama e foningeyaan nin,
e siimayaan yi raɲan yagin ma yalundene tagi.
Koni, Ala tɔrɔ muxune rakisima
e tɔrɔn nan xɔn,
a yi e rakolon ɲaxankatan xɔn.
A i tan fan bama nɛn tɔrɔni,
a yi dɔxɔde rafulunxin fi i ma,
a yi i ya tabanla rafe donse faɲine ra.”
“Koni iki,
kitin naxan nagidixi fe ɲaxi rabane xili ma,
na bata i sɔtɔ,
Ala to a kiti kɛndɛn sa i xili ma,
a yi i yalagi.
Nayi, xɔlɔn nama i radin
i yi fe kobin liga,
i nama xɛtɛ Ala fɔxɔ ra
bayo na saren gbo.
I ya nafunle i bɛ tɔrɔni ba?
Hali i sɛnbɛ gbeen mi nɔɛ i maliyɛ iki.
A xɔli nama i suxu kɔɛɛn xa so,
alogo i xa muxune ba e konne yi.
A liga i yeren ma!
I nama fa hakɛn liga sɔnɔn,
i bata yi gbalon sɔtɔ na fe ra.
I xa a kolon
a Alaa binyen gbo a sɛnbɛni.
Nde nɔɛ xaranna tiyɛ alo a tan?
Nde kiraan yitaxi a ra?
Nde nɔɛ a falɛ, a naxa,
‘I bata tinxintareyaan liga?’ ”
“I nama ɲinan Alaa wanle matɔxɔn ma,
muxune birin naxanye fe falama e bɛtine yi,
adamadiine birin nɔɛ naxanye toɛ,
e yi e mato wulani.
Ala gbo yati,
en mi a gboon danna kolon,
a siimayaan dan mi na.
A na igen nate wuyenni kore,
a yi na findi tulen na mɛnni.
Na tulen yi keli kundane yi,
a godo adamadiine ma.
Nde nɔɛ kundaan nafala kiin kolonɲɛ,
e nun galanna godon kii naxan yi keli kore?
A mato, a kuyen ɲin masɔxɔnna raminima a rabilinni,
a fɔxɔ igen nafema
han dimin yi so a tilinna ma.
A yamaan makitima na tulen nan xɔn,
a donse gbegbe fi e ma.
A galanna tongoma a yii firinne nan na,
a yi a ragodo a na wa dɛnaxan xɔn.
A kuye sarinna a fa feen nan mayitama,
hali xuruseene a fa feen kolon.”
